title: 第17章 你指望我一边打工一边拯救世界吗
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: 苏沐雪走在前头，原本打理得一丝不苟的黑长直有些凌乱。手里提着一摞关于《华夏神话考究》、《民间野史杂谈》的书籍。塑料袋的提手勒红了她白嫩的手指。她在图书馆泡了整整一天。把那些发黄的故纸堆翻了个底朝天，试图从字里行间找到上一世夏晚晴觉醒的具体坐标和时间节点。明天就是夏晚晴崛起的日子。上一世，就是在这场全校测试之后，夏晚晴唤醒了那位传说中的齐天大圣，成了华夏的顶梁柱。但神像在哪？上一世她因为神力亲和度测试不合格，直接被清理出现场，根本没资格留下。苏沐雪把资料放在玄关柜上。她抬起眼皮，扫了一眼客厅。电视机里正放着都市情感剧，茶几上摆着一堆嗑出来的瓜子皮。叶凛正瘫在沙发上。“回来了？”叶凛手里捏着遥控器，声音懒洋洋的。苏沐雪看着他这副样子，无奈地摇了摇头。她在外面为了寻找机缘跑断了腿，叶凛居然在家里看电视。“叶凛，你知不知道现在局势有多乱？”苏沐雪换上拖鞋，一股恨铁不成钢的语气。“明天就是神力亲和度测试了，你就算没有天赋，好歹也看看书，临时抱抱佛脚也好啊。”叶凛换了个更舒服的姿势，把腿架在茶几边缘，顺手抓了一把瓜子。“看书能长力气还是能发工钱？”“拯救世界这种事情，不适合我这种打工人。”苏沐雪被噎住了。她盯着叶凛那张毫无斗志的脸，心里叹息。上一世，她根本没听说过叶凛这号人物。估计就是个在第一波神话复苏时就挂掉的普通人。自已是重生者，大家同学一场，她能劝还是想劝一把。“咱们年轻人现在正好赶上了时代变革。”“你哪怕只是去混个脸熟，说不定也能碰到属于自已的机缘。”“好事可不会送上门。”苏沐雪的劝告也是真心的。神话复苏第一年，是遍地都是黄金的时代。苏沐雪希望叶凛变强，倒不是为了什么，而是别拖夏晚晴后腿。叶凛一个翻身，不理会苏沐雪的苦口婆心。他还在脑袋里逛系统商店呢。“你这人，真是说不听！”苏沐雪无奈地叹了口气，刚准备回房间。就在这时，防盗门被猛地推开。“热死老娘了！”夏晚晴风风火火地撞了进来。她身上穿着那件显眼的黄色外卖马甲，里面是一件已经被汗水浸透的黑色运动背心。那种充满了爆发力的、线条流畅的肌肉，正随着她的呼吸在皮肤下微微起伏。小麦色的皮肤上挂满了汗珠，顺着她修长的脖颈滑入锁骨窝。她整个人散发着惊人的热量。苏沐雪刚要关门的动作僵住了。她猛地回头，死死盯着夏晚晴。不对劲。夏晚晴这实力，明显已经超越了普通人的极限。“晚晴，你这是……”苏沐雪赶紧迎上去，顺手接过夏晚晴手里的头盔。“累坏了吧？快坐快坐，我去给你倒水！”夏晚晴摆了摆手，大步走到沙发前。“别提了！”“今天这身体不知道怎么回事，劲儿大得没处使！”“送餐的时候我就稍微跑快了点，结果差点把人家的防盗门给拽下来，赔了五十块钱才走人！”夏晚晴一边说着，一边毫无形象地抓起茶几上的凉水壶，仰头就灌。水流顺着她的下巴淌过，最后没入那起伏剧烈的胸口。苏沐雪站在一旁，眼睛亮得吓人。这就是未来的女武神！还没有真正觉醒，就已经展现出了如此恐怖的潜力。自已这大腿算是抱对了！叶凛瞥了一眼，心里有数。估计是“晨曦玫瑰”精油的效果。阿芙洛狄忒出品的东西确实是硬通货。仅仅一次推拿，就让夏晚晴的身体素质突破了凡人的极限。“好事啊。”叶凛嗑了一颗瓜子，慢悠悠地点评。“说明你有把子力气，以后送外卖能多接两单。”夏晚晴放下水壶，抹了一把嘴，直接一屁股坐在叶凛旁边。那条结实有力的大长腿甚至碰到了叶凛的膝盖。“什么送外卖！”“老叶，你能不能有点出息！”夏晚晴伸手就去搂叶凛的脖子。这是一个标准的哥们之间的动作。苏沐雪看着两人亲昵的举动，心里有些羡慕，又有些着急。晚晴对叶凛这么好，叶凛要是再这么咸鱼下去，迟早会被时代淘汰。“晚晴说得对。”苏沐雪赶紧附和，顺势给夏晚晴递了张纸巾。“叶凛，晚晴现在这么厉害，你也得努力跟上她的步伐啊。”叶凛稍微往后仰了仰，避开了夏晚晴身上传来的热气，脸上写满了嫌弃。“有屁快放。”叶凛把手里的瓜子盘递了过去，挡在两人中间。“别动手动脚的，男女授受不亲，懂不懂？”“我可是正经人。”“切，装什么纯情少男。”“以前穿开裆裤的时候谁没见过谁啊。”夏晚晴翻了个大大的白眼，抓了一把瓜子，咔嚓咔嚓地嗑了起来。“说正事儿。”夏晚晴突然压低了声音。“我今天提前下班，去市体育馆试了一下。”“百米冲刺，我跑进了七秒！”“立定跳远，我跳出了六米五！”“看我牛逼不？”夏晚晴越说越激动，抓着叶凛肩膀的手也不自觉地用力。“不看，撒手。”叶凛拍开她的爪子，揉了揉肩膀。“什么不看？”“算了现在不是说这个的时候！”“明天要举行神力亲和度测试你不知道吗？”这个词一出，站在一旁的苏沐雪身体猛地一震。终于来了。神话复苏的序幕，凡人登天的阶梯。这也是她重生的起点。她知道明天就是那个关键日子。哪怕要把整个学校翻个底朝天，她也要找到孙悟空的神像！只要抱紧夏晚晴这条大腿，只要能蹭到一点点机缘。“测试？”叶凛挑了挑眉，“哦。”“那祝你考个好成绩。”“争取保送个好单位，以后发达了别忘了拉兄弟一把。”夏晚晴被叶凛这副油盐不进的样子气笑了。她一把勒住叶凛的脖子，把他整个人往怀里带。“少废话！”“你也得去！”“我不管你是不是想当咸鱼，但这可是改变命运的机会！”“万一你也被哪个神明看上了呢？”夏晚晴的眼里满是希冀。她其实心里也没底。但她不想一个人。在这个未知的、即将崩坏的世界里。如果她能觉醒，她希望能保护叶凛。如果叶凛也能觉醒，那就是他们在这个乱世里活下去的资本。苏沐雪在一旁看着，忍不住插嘴：“叶凛，你就听晚晴的吧，去试试又不少块肉。”“万一真的成为了神明的信徒，那以后可就发达了。”她是真怕叶凛不去，影响了夏晚晴的心情和发挥。她不知道两人关系如何，是不是男女朋友，插手不了两人的感情。但上一世的夏晚晴似乎没有伴侣，那只能说明叶凛死了。苏沐雪也想好了。实在不行，自已利用重生的优势，告诉叶凛一个神明的名字和事迹，让他也成为代行者。也免得夏晚晴伤心。叶凛被勒得有点缺氧。他感受着脖颈处传来的温热，还有夏晚晴那剧烈跳动的心跳声。这个傻丫头。明明自已都紧张得手心冒汗，还要装出一副大姐大的样子来罩着他。叶凛的视线扫过系统空间角落里，那本他在蟠桃园值班时，当着孙悟空的面随手涂鸦的笔记本。《悟空传》。这丫头从小就喜欢这些热血的东西，成为孙悟空的代行者，或许才是她想要的。“行吧。”叶凛叹了口气，把夏晚晴的手臂从脖子上扒拉下来。“去就去。”“不过说好了。”“要是测出来我是个废物，你不许笑话我。”夏晚晴瞬间笑开了花。那个笑容灿烂得像是正午的烈阳。“放心！”“要是你是废物，姐养你！”“要是我是废物……”夏晚晴顿了顿。“那我就继续送外卖养你！”叶凛伸手拍了拍夏晚晴的脑袋。“放心，你成不了废物。”“而且……”叶凛看着她，语气随意。“为了祝福你明天一飞冲天，我给你准备了个小礼物。”“礼物？”夏晚晴眼睛一亮，“什么礼物？我要吃学校门口那家烤猪蹄！”“庸俗。”叶凛嫌弃地撇撇嘴。“到时候你就知道了。”“那是能让你把天捅个窟窿的好东西。”站在旁边的苏沐雪，看着这一幕，心里五味杂陈。这就是羁绊吗？这就是未来女武神之所以强大的原因吗？即便是在微末之时，也有着想要守护的人。只是……苏沐雪的视线落在叶凛身上，带着几分惋惜。可惜了。在这个神明即是真理的时代，凡人的羁绊，是最脆弱的东西。叶凛这种没有野心、没有天赋、只知道混吃等死的咸鱼，注定只能成为夏晚晴成神路上的累赘。“那明天早上八点。”苏沐雪看了看表，打断了那边的“温情时刻”。“我们在操场集合。”“叶凛，你别迟到。”说完，她转身走进房间，轻轻关上了门。
content_en: Su Muxue walked in front, her long black hair, which had been meticulously taken care of, a bit messy.He was holding a stack of books on "Study of Chinese Mythology" and "Miscellaneous Folk History" in his hand.The handle of the plastic bag pinched her white fingers red.She spent the whole day in the library.I turned over the pile of yellowed old papers, trying to find between the lines the specific coordinates and time node of Xia Wanqing's awakening in the previous life.Tomorrow is the day when Xia Wanqing rises.In the last life, after this school-wide test, Xia Wanqing awakened the legendary Monkey King and became the backbone of China.But where is the idol?In her last life, she failed the divine affinity test and was kicked out of the scene. She was not qualified to stay at all.Su Muxue put the information on the entrance cabinet.She raised her eyelids and glanced at the living room.An urban emotional drama was playing on the TV, and there was a pile of chewed melon seed peels on the coffee table.Ye Lin was slumped on the sofa."Come back?" Ye Lin held the remote control in his hand and spoke lazily.Su Muxue looked at his appearance and shook her head helplessly.She broke her leg while running outside looking for opportunities, while Ye Lin was watching TV at home."Ye Lin, do you know how chaotic the situation is right now?" Su Muxue put on her slippers with a tone of hatred."Tomorrow is the divine affinity test. Even if you don't have any talent, you can at least read a book and hold the Buddha's feet temporarily." Ye Lin changed to a more comfortable position, put his legs on the edge of the coffee table, and grabbed a handful of melon seeds."Will reading help me gain strength or get paid?" "Saving the world is not suitable for a worker like me." Su Muxue was choked.She stared at Ye Lin's face without fighting spirit and sighed in her heart.In her last life, she had never heard of Ye Lin.He was probably just an ordinary person who died during the first wave of mythical revival.She is a reborn person, and when we are classmates, she can persuade her or she wants to."We young people are just in time to catch up with the changes of the times." "Even if you just go and get familiar with each other, you might be able to encounter your own opportunities." "Good things will not come to your door." Su Muxue's advice was also sincere.The first year of Shinhwa's revival was a golden age everywhere.Su Muxue hopes that Ye Lin will become stronger, not for any reason, but not to hold back Xia Wanqing.Ye Lin turned over and ignored Su Muxue's earnest words.He was still browsing the system store in his head."You really don't listen!" Su Muxue sighed helplessly and was about to go back to the room.At this moment, the security door was pushed open violently."I'm so hot!" Xia Wanqing came in furiously.She was wearing the conspicuous yellow take-out vest, and underneath was a black sports vest that was soaked with sweat.The muscles with smooth lines, full of explosive power, were undulating slightly under the skin as she breathed.Beads of sweat hung on her wheat-colored skin, sliding down her slender neck into her collarbone.Her whole body radiated amazing heat.Su Muxue froze when she was about to close the door.She turned back sharply and stared at Xia Wanqing.Something is wrong.Xia Wanqing's strength has obviously exceeded the limits of ordinary people."Wanqing, what are you..." Su Muxue hurriedly stepped forward and took the helmet from Xia Wanqing's hand."Are you tired? Sit down, sit down, I'll get you some water!" Xia Wanqing waved her hand and strode to the sofa."Don't mention it!" "I don't know what happened to my body today. I have so much energy that I can't use it!" "I ran a little faster when delivering the food, and almost pulled down the security door of the house. I paid fifty yuan before I left!" As Xia Wanqing said this, she grabbed the cold water bottle on the coffee table and drank it.The water flowed down her chin and finally submerged into the violently rising and falling chest.Su Muxue stood aside, her eyes frighteningly bright.This is the future Valkyrie!It has already shown such terrifying potential before it has truly awakened.My thighs are right!Ye Lin glanced at it and knew what was going on.It is probably the effect of "Morning Rose" essential oil.The stuff Aphrodite produces is indeed hard currency.With just one massage, Xia Wanqing's physical fitness exceeded the limits of mortals."That's a good thing." Ye Lin chewed a melon seed and commented slowly."It shows that you have enough strength. You can take two more orders when delivering food in the future." Xia Wanqing put down the kettle, wiped her mouth, and sat down next to Ye Lin.The long, strong legs even touched Ye Lin's knees."What are you talking about delivering takeaways!" "Old Ye, can you be successful?" Xia Wanqing reached out to hug Ye Lin's neck.This is a standard move between buddies.Su Muxue looked at the two people's intimate actions, feeling a little envious and a little anxious.Wan Qing is so kind to Ye Lin. If Ye Lin continues to be like this, he will be eliminated by the times sooner or later."Wan Qing is right." Su Muxue quickly agreed and handed Xia Wanqing a tissue."Ye Lin, Wan Qing is so powerful now, you have to work hard to keep up with her." Ye Lin leaned back slightly to avoid the heat coming from Xia Wanqing's body, with disgust written on his face."If you fart, hurry up." Ye Lin handed over the plate of melon seeds in his hand and put it between the two of them."Don't get involved. Men and women don't kiss each other, do you understand?" "I'm a serious person." "Oh, why are you pretending to be an innocent boy?" "I haven't seen anyone wearing crotchless pants before." Xia Wanqing rolled her eyes, grabbed a handful of melon seeds, and started to crackle them."Let's get down to business." Xia Wanqing suddenly lowered her voice."I got off work early today and went to the city gym to try it out." "In the 100-meter sprint, I ran under seven seconds!" "In the standing long jump, I jumped 6.5 meters!" "Do you think I'm awesome?""Don't look, let go." Ye Lin slapped her paw away and rubbed her shoulders."Why don't you look at it?" "Forget it, now is not the time to talk about this!" "Don't you know that there will be a divine affinity test tomorrow?" As soon as this word came out, Su Muxue's body shook violently.It's finally here.The prelude to the revival of myth and the ladder for mortals to ascend to heaven.This is also the starting point of her rebirth.She knew that tomorrow was the crucial day.Even if she has to turn the whole school upside down, she still has to find the statue of Sun Wukong!As long as she hugs Xia Wanqing's thigh tightly, as long as she can get a little chance."Test?" Ye Lin raised his eyebrows, "Oh." "Then I wish you good grades." "Try to be recommended to a good unit. Don't forget to help your brothers when you get prosperous in the future." Xia Wanqing laughed angrily at Ye Lin's indifferent look.She grabbed Ye Lin's neck and brought him into her arms."Stop talking nonsense!" "You have to go too!" "I don't care if you want to be a salted fish, but this is an opportunity to change your destiny!" "What if you are also attracted by some god?" Xia Wanqing's eyes were full of hope.In fact, she didn't know what to do.But she doesn't want to be alone.In this unknown world that is about to collapse.If she can awaken, she hopes to protect Ye Lin.If Ye Lin can also awaken, it will be their capital to survive in this troubled world.Su Muxue watched from the side and couldn't help but interject: "Ye Lin, just listen to Wan Qing and try a lot of meat." "If you really become a believer in the gods, you will be prosperous in the future." She was really afraid that Ye Lin's not going would affect Xia Wanqing's mood and performance.She didn't know what their relationship was like, whether they were boyfriend or girlfriend, and she couldn't interfere in their relationship.But Xia Wanqing seemed to have no partner in her previous life, which could only mean that Ye Lin was dead.Su Muxue also thought about it.If that didn't work, he took advantage of his rebirth and told Ye Lin the name and deeds of a god, so that he could also become his agent.It also prevents Xia Wanqing from being sad.Ye Lin was strangled and was a little short of oxygen.He felt the warmth coming from his neck, as well as Xia Wanqing's violently beating heartbeat.This silly girl.Even though she was so nervous that her palms were sweating, she still had to pretend to be a big sister to protect him.Ye Lin's eyes glanced at the corner of the system space, the notebook he had scribbled in front of Sun Wukong when he was on duty in Pantaoyuan."The Legend of Wukong".This girl has liked these passionate things since she was a child. Perhaps becoming the representative of Sun Wukong is what she wants."Okay." Ye Lin sighed and pulled Xia Wanqing's arm off her neck."Just go." "But we agreed." "If it turns out I'm a loser, you're not allowed to laugh at me." Xia Wanqing burst into laughter instantly.That smile was as bright as the midday sun."Don't worry!" "If you are a waste, I will support you!" "If I am a waste..." Xia Wanqing paused."Then I will continue to deliver food to support you!" Ye Lin reached out and patted Xia Wanqing's head."Don't worry, you won't become a waste." "And..." Ye Lin looked at her with a casual tone."To wish you a great success tomorrow, I prepared a small gift for you." "Gift?""You'll know when the time comes." "That's a good thing that can make you poke a hole in the sky." Su Muxue, who was standing nearby, looked at this scene with mixed feelings in her heart.Is this a bond?Is this why the future Valkyrie is so powerful?Even in his weakest moments, there are still people he wants to protect.It's just...Su Muxue's eyes fell on Ye Lin, with a bit of regret.What a pity.In this era where gods are the truth, the bonds of mortals are the most fragile things.Ye Lin, a salty fish with no ambition or talent who only knows how to eat and die, is destined to become a burden on Xia Wanqing's journey to becoming a god."Then it will be eight o'clock tomorrow morning." Su Muxue looked at her watch and interrupted the "warm moment" over there."Let's meet at the playground." "Ye Lin, don't be late." After saying that, she turned around and walked into the room, closing the door gently.
